datasets.name: PointCrack3D research
datasets.purpose: 3D natural-rock crack detection and point-density requirements.
datasets.license: Verify separate dataset and software reuse terms.
datasets.limitation: Published results do not establish GeoGuard performance. Public DEMs are not crack-resolution lidar.

datasets.name: PTZ rockfall detection and tracking research (2026)
datasets.purpose: Temporal video detection and tracking as a distinct monitoring task.
datasets.license: Publisher open-access article; verify separate dataset terms.
datasets.limitation: Temporal real and simulated events differ from still-image screening. No model or accuracy is imported.

datasets.name: Open-pit coal mine slope crack dataset (ScienceDB)
datasets.purpose: Candidate mine-domain imagery for future held-out crack training.
datasets.status: Catalog discovered; files and licensing not verified
datasets.limitation: Not used in models or benchmark metrics.

datasets.name: Tongjiang Aerial Dataset
datasets.purpose: Actual UAV quarry XYZ/RGB survey; original source retained and checksum-verified, with 900000 measured samples prepared for 3D rendering.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0; Chen, Fang and Zhang; doi:10.5281/zenodo.15614501
datasets.limitation: Survey acquired 2025-05-21; local coordinates, no published absolute CRS or independent ground-control accuracy.

datasets.name: USGS 3DEP and National Map imagery
datasets.purpose: Bingham Canyon actual elevation surface with aligned USDA/USGS orthoimagery, source-coordinate inspection and scale-preserving 3D measurement.
datasets.license: Elevation data courtesy of USGS; USDA, USGS The National Map: Orthoimagery.
datasets.limitation: Historical multi-resolution mosaic; 6.5 m display sampling is not a 1 m survey accuracy claim. Source dates and vertical datum vary.

datasets.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles on AWS
datasets.purpose: Coordinate-based global elevation context; decoded Terrarium tiles reprojected into local UTM and exportable as GeoTIFF.
datasets.license: Mapzen and contributing source agencies; retain the published attribution linked in metadata.
datasets.limitation: Regional context only; source resolution and dates vary and may predate current mine excavation.

datasets.name: CRACK-CH
datasets.purpose: Downloaded and checksum-verified labelled stone images. A separate XGBoost feature baseline is evaluated on a held-out acquisition site.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 Â· Agrafiotis, Doulamis and Georgopoulos Â· doi:10.5281/zenodo.6516913
datasets.limitation: 60 masonry patches across two sites; no mine failures, weather labels or pixel masks. Excluded from warnings.

datasets.name: Open-Meteo
datasets.purpose: Live coordinate-based 72-hour modelled precipitation history and 48-hour forecast, saved with each assessment.
datasets.license: Data CC BY 4.0; free endpoint for non-commercial use. Commercial deployment requires an appropriate service plan.
datasets.limitation: Gridded model output is not a mine rain gauge. Forecast windows indicate weather exposure, not rockfall time.

datasets.name: NASA COOLR
datasets.purpose: Reproducible download of a bounded sample of mapped landslide-event polygons for contextual GIS research.
datasets.license: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center; retain inventory-specific citation and contributor terms in the downloaded properties.
datasets.limitation: Regional event inventories, not a matched mine-level event/non-event dataset. Never used as negative samples or to train failure probabilities.

datasets.name: ReachBot rock crack dataset
datasets.purpose: Research route for manually annotated rock-face crack segmentation and thin-line metrics such as LineAcc.
datasets.license: Check dataset-specific terms in the authors' linked Google Drive release before reuse.
datasets.limitation: A rock-crack segmentation task does not provide time-to-failure labels. No claim of integration or training on this dataset.

datasets.name: Mountain Rockfall Dataset
datasets.purpose: Candidate future benchmark for detecting rockfall objects in mountain scenes.
datasets.license: Academic / educational use; annotation licence CC BY 4.0 does not override third-party image rights. Publisher download uses Baidu.
datasets.limitation: Detects visible rockfall objects, not precursor cracks or future event times. The README image total and listed split totals differ; verify the release before use.

datasets.name: SDNET2018
datasets.purpose: Large concrete-crack classification benchmark considered for future transfer-learning experiments.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 Â· Maguire, Dorafshan and Thomas Â· doi:10.15142/T3TD19
datasets.limitation: Concrete deck, wall and pavement patches differ from mine rock faces; classification labels are not segmentation masks or failure labels.

datasets.name: Bundled rockfall CSV
datasets.purpose: Existing 200-row synthetic geotechnical classifier retained for paper-method comparison and TreeSHAP demonstration.
datasets.license: Local prototype dataset; authorship and redistribution licence require confirmation.
datasets.limitation: 100% random-split accuracy is synthetic-demo performance, not mine validation. Classifier and 70/30 paper comparison are excluded from warning generation.
